decisions.reason: As a named dietary supplement range with its own page, it reflects visible investment and a public commitment that management is likely to continue supporting after only one year.
Its own page and explicit launch message make the commitment highly visible, so management is likely to justify the launch and give this adjacent OTC product more time.
Although the website commitment is weaker than for A and B, it still fits the supplement portfolio and is recent enough that mediocre early results can be seen as temporary.

This niche immune supplement appears less central and less prominently backed than the other launches, but escalation of commitment still makes an early withdrawal less likely than continued market testing.

Despite the 2018 Valsartan problem notice, a generic blood pressure medicine is much closer to the firm's core pharmaceutical business, and management can attribute the setback to a temporary product-specific issue rather than abandon it quickly.
